Label: Originator ID
Description: Stable identifier for the NGO, MFI, federation or employer network that originated the asset.
Validation: matches pattern; must exist in originator table
Why_It_Matters: Multi-originator pooling is the aggregation strategy (LIT-008, LIT-011). Without a clean originator key you cannot measure originator-level performance dispersion, which is what an investor prices when several originators feed one vehicle.

Label: Originator type
Description: Category of originating institution.
Allowed_Values: ngo; mfi; savings_group_federation; employer_network; cooperative; bank; other
Why_It_Matters: Regulatory treatment and true-sale mechanics differ by institution type (LIT-009). Also a control variable when comparing performance across originators.

Label: Country
Description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the originating institution.
Why_It_Matters: Determines which legal checklist applies (LIT-009 six-point test) and whether receivables can be assigned cross-border into the SPV.

Label: Regulated entity
Description: Whether the originator is a licensed/supervised financial institution in its jurisdiction.
Why_It_Matters: Bears directly on whether receivables are legally transferable and on the consumer-protection regime that applies (LIT-014).

Label: Group ID
Description: Pseudonymous identifier for the savings group or originating unit. Never the group's real name.
Why_It_Matters: The join key for the whole schema. Pseudonymous by construction so the analysis and pooling layer never touches identifying data (CLAUDE.md 8).

Label: Originator
Description: Which originator supports this group.
Why_It_Matters: Concentration by originator is a pool-level risk an investor will ask about before anything else.

Label: Formation date
Description: Date the group first formed, not the date it entered our programme.
Why_It_Matters: Group age is the strongest cheaply-observable proxy for governance maturity. Cannot be reconstructed once the founding members have turned over.

Label: Cycle number
Description: Which savings cycle the group is in at the point of origination. First cycle = 1.
Why_It_Matters: A group in cycle 5 has survived four share-outs. Cycle count is the single best available track-record signal before we have repayment history of our own.

Label: Cycle length (months)
Description: Length of the savings cycle before share-out.
Why_It_Matters: Share-out is a hard liquidity event that empties the box. Any loan maturing after share-out has a structurally different risk profile, and the model cannot infer this later.

Label: Members at origination
Description: Number of active members when the loan was originated.
Why_It_Matters: Denominator for joint-liability capacity. A five-member group guaranteeing a large loan is a different asset from a thirty-member group doing the same.

Label: Governance model
Description: How the group is constituted and supervised.
Allowed_Values: standard_vsla; federated; ngo_managed; employer_linked; informal_rosca; other
Why_It_Matters: Governance is the mechanism the whole PL-1 thesis rests on (Memo 1). Needs to be a controlled variable, not a free-text note.

Label: Meeting frequency
Description: How often the group meets to collect savings and repayments.
Why_It_Matters: Sets the natural repayment cadence and therefore the cash-flow granularity available to a waterfall. Also the monitoring frequency ceiling for RT-3.

Label: Group savings balance
Description: Total group savings held at the point of origination, in local currency.
Why_It_Matters: The internal loss-absorbing layer that sits beneath any external first-loss tranche. Sizing the junior layer (OQ-6) without knowing it double-counts protection.

Label: Currency
Description: ISO 4217 currency of the group's ledger.
Why_It_Matters: Every amount in this schema is meaningless without it. FX mismatch against a hard-currency tranche is a named risk in the business plan.

Label: Region (admin level 1)
Description: First-level administrative region. Deliberately coarse - no GPS, no village name.
Why_It_Matters: Geographic concentration drives correlated default, the parameter RT-5 is most sensitive to. Coarse enough not to identify a group; fine enough to model a regional drought.

Label: District (admin level 2)
Description: Second-level administrative area.
Why_It_Matters: Improves correlation modelling but narrows anonymity. Optional by design - collect only where the cohort is large enough that it does not identify a group.

Label: Climate zone
Description: Coarse agro-climatic classification.
Allowed_Values: arid; semi_arid; sub_humid; humid; highland; urban; peri_urban
Why_It_Matters: The link between the ENSO and food-price indicators on the macro watch and this pool's expected stress. Without it a weather shock cannot be mapped to a cohort.

Label: SAVIX ID
Description: Identifier in the SAVIX savings-group MIS, where the group is already registered.
Why_It_Matters: If populated, historical group data can be mapped in without re-collection. This is potentially the difference between a pilot of 20 groups and a pool of hundreds (RT-1 open question).

Label: Schema version
Description: Version of this schema the record was captured under.
Why_It_Matters: A mixed-vintage portfolio without version stamps is uninterpretable. Cannot be backfilled because you no longer know which rules applied.

Label: Member ID
Description: Pseudonymous member identifier. The mapping to a real identity lives only in the Vault.
Why_It_Matters: Lets borrower-level performance be modelled without any personal data entering the repo or the pool. The separation is what makes the whole dataset publishable in aggregate.

Label: Group
Description: Group the member belongs to.
Why_It_Matters: Joint liability only means anything if membership is known at the time of the loan.

Label: Join date
Description: Date the member joined the group.
Why_It_Matters: Tenure in the group is a screening signal available at zero cost, and it is gone once records turn over.

Label: Role
Description: Position held in the group at origination.
Allowed_Values: member; chair; secretary; treasurer; box_keeper; key_holder
Why_It_Matters: Officeholders have different incentives and different access to the box. Relevant to fraud risk, which LIT-014 flags as the real consumer-protection concern in savings groups.

Label: Sex
Description: Self-reported. Undisclosed is a valid and non-penalised answer.
Why_It_Matters: Female economic agency is among the most robust findings in the microfinance evidence base (LIT-003, Memo 2). Needed in aggregate for impact reporting. Aggregate only - never published at row level.

Label: Age band
Description: Banded rather than exact date of birth, deliberately.
Why_It_Matters: Banding gives the cohort analysis value while removing a direct identifier. Exact DOB would be personal data with no additional analytical benefit.

Label: Primary livelihood
Description: Main income source.
Allowed_Values: smallholder_farming; livestock; petty_trade; wage_labour; salaried; artisan; remittance_dependent; mixed; other
Why_It_Matters: The transmission channel from a macro shock to this borrower. A food-price spike hits a smallholder and a salaried worker in opposite directions; without this the macro watch cannot be connected to the pool.

Label: Prior cycles completed
Description: Number of full savings cycles this member has completed with the group.
Why_It_Matters: The closest thing to a credit history that exists for this population, and the primary input to RT-2's first rules-based score.

Label: Schema version
Description: Version of this schema the record was captured under.
Why_It_Matters: Member records are the longest-lived rows in the schema and will outlast several schema versions. Without a stamp you cannot tell whether a null age band means undisclosed or not-yet-collected.

Label: Loan ID
Description: Unique loan identifier.
Why_It_Matters: The unit of the data tape. Every ABS reporting template is loan-level (RES-28).

Label: Group
Description: Originating group.
Why_It_Matters: Group is the concentration unit for joint-liability lending.

Label: Borrower
Description: Borrowing member.
Why_It_Matters: Links the loan to a borrowing history. Borrower-level default behaviour is what RT-2 learns from, and joint-liability recovery depends on knowing which member the group is standing behind.

Label: Disbursement date
Description: Date funds were actually released, not the date approved.
Why_It_Matters: Time zero for every cash-flow calculation. An approval date substituted here silently corrupts every vintage curve built from the pool.

Label: Principal
Description: Amount disbursed, in the group's currency.
Why_It_Matters: Exposure at origination - the single number every loss, recovery and tranche calculation is a proportion of. Irreducible and unreconstructible once the ledger moves on.

Label: Currency
Description: ISO 4217 currency of the loan.
Why_It_Matters: Bare amounts are unusable in a multi-country pool. Also the FX exposure the business plan flags as a live risk.

Label: Term (days)
Description: Contractual term from disbursement to final scheduled payment.
Why_It_Matters: Weighted average life drives the tranche structure. Days rather than months because VSLA loans are often cycle-bound and short.

Label: Repayment frequency
Description: Contractual repayment cadence.
Why_It_Matters: Determines collection timing into the waterfall. A bullet loan and a weekly amortiser with the same term are completely different assets to a senior noteholder.

Label: Scheduled instalments
Description: Number of scheduled payments over the term.
Validation: 1 <= x <= 156; consistent with term and frequency
Why_It_Matters: Lets the expected schedule be reconstructed, which is the baseline every arrears calculation is measured against.

Label: Charge rate (%)
Description: Service charge or interest rate as quoted to the borrower.
Why_It_Matters: Gross yield on the asset, and the first input to whether a structure can cover its costs and still pay a senior coupon.

Label: Charge basis
Description: How the charge is computed. VSLAs typically use a flat monthly service charge, not declining balance.
Why_It_Matters: A flat monthly charge and a declining-balance rate of the same nominal number are materially different yields. Getting this wrong misprices the whole pool.

Label: Use of proceeds
Description: Primary stated purpose of the loan.
Allowed_Values: agriculture_input; livestock; trade_stock; equipment; education; health; housing; emergency_consumption; energy_asset; debt_refinance; other
Why_It_Matters: Both an impact-reporting field and a risk field: an agricultural-input loan is exposed to the same harvest the borrower repays from, which is correlated risk hiding inside an apparently diversified pool.

Label: Guarantee structure
Description: What stands behind the loan if the borrower does not pay.
Allowed_Values: group_joint_liability; social_collateral; cash_savings_pledge; physical_collateral; external_guarantee; none
Why_It_Matters: The credit-enhancement layer already present inside the asset. Cannot be reconstructed after the fact, and directly changes loss-given-default.

Label: Guarantee coverage (%)
Description: Share of principal covered by the guarantee structure.
Why_It_Matters: Required to avoid double-counting protection between the internal guarantee and an external first-loss tranche (OQ-6).

Label: Borrower savings at disbursement
Description: The borrower's own savings balance in the group at disbursement.
Why_It_Matters: Skin in the game, and the classic VSLA underwriting ratio. Recoverable only at the moment of disbursement.

Label: Loan-to-savings ratio
Description: Principal divided by borrower savings at disbursement.
Why_It_Matters: Derived rather than captured, so it can never disagree with its inputs. The primary underwriting ratio in most savings-group methodologies.

Label: Prior loans
Description: Number of loans this borrower has previously taken in this group.
Why_It_Matters: Repeat borrowing is the strongest single predictor available pre-track-record, and it is a point-in-time fact that cannot be rebuilt later.

Label: First-loss provider
Description: External guarantor or first-loss provider, where one exists.
Why_It_Matters: Attribution of mobilised capital to the first-loss provider follows OECD practice (LIT-012, LIT-013). Needs to be traceable per loan to be reportable.

Label: Schema version
Description: Version of this schema the record was captured under.
Why_It_Matters: Loans are the unit of the data tape. A pool mixing two schema vintages without stamps cannot be reconciled to either definition, and a rating agency will treat that as unaudited data.

Label: Event ID
Description: Unique identifier for a payment or status event.
Why_It_Matters: The event table is the asset. Static loan attributes are cheap; the payment-behaviour time series is what an investor actually prices.

Label: Loan
Description: Loan the event belongs to.
Why_It_Matters: Orphan events are unusable; referential integrity is checked by the validator.

Label: Event date
Description: Date the event occurred, not the date it was recorded.
Why_It_Matters: Payment timing is the whole cash flow. A recording date substituted for an occurrence date makes every DPD calculation wrong in a direction that flatters the pool.

Label: Event type
Description: What happened.
Allowed_Values: scheduled_repayment; early_repayment; partial_repayment; missed_payment; arrears_flagged; restructure; write_off; recovery; insurance_claim; insurance_payout; share_out
Why_It_Matters: Distinguishing a missed payment from a restructure from a write-off is the difference between a delinquency curve and a loss curve. Collapsing them destroys both.

Label: Amount
Description: Cash amount of the event. Zero is valid and distinct from null.
Why_It_Matters: A missed payment of zero and no record at all are different facts. Nulls-as-zeros is the most common silent corruption in loan tapes.

Label: Principal component
Description: Portion of the amount applied to principal.
Why_It_Matters: Allows principal and yield cash flows to be split in the waterfall. Derivable from the schedule if absent, which is why it is optional rather than required.

Label: Balance after
Description: Outstanding principal immediately after the event.
Why_It_Matters: The reconciliation anchor. Lets the validator catch a broken payment sequence rather than discovering it during a data-tape review.

Label: Days past due
Description: DPD at the time of the event.
Why_It_Matters: The input to RT-3's early-warning thresholds and to every delinquency bucket a rating agency will ask for.

Label: Recorded by
Description: Role of the person who recorded the event.
Allowed_Values: secretary; treasurer; chair; field_officer; automated; other
Why_It_Matters: Provenance for audit. A verification partner will want to know whether a figure was self-reported by the group or observed by a field officer.

Label: Schema version
Description: Version of this schema the record was captured under.
Why_It_Matters: Event definitions are the most likely part of this schema to change as field practice settles. Without a stamp, a change in what counts as arrears silently rewrites the history of every prior vintage.
